title: ELEV8R 18mm Rig Adapter (All Glass)
description:
Elev8r 18mm Rig Adapter All Glass
The all glass Elev8r vaporizer water pipe adapter will turn any glass rig with a 18mm connection into a vaporizing powerhouse.
Please keep in mind that if you are wanting a functional elev8r you will also need the Elev8r heater to complete the kit.
These rig adapters are also compatible with most injector style vaporizers such as the Freight Train.
Included
1 x Elev8r 18mm Water Pipe Adapter
